children: L&T Finance reported its highest-ever consolidated profit after tax of Rs 975 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, up 33 per cent year-on-year, supported by growth in its retail portfolio, improving asset quality and lower credit costs.

The non-banking financial company’s consolidated loan book reached a record Rs 1,36,635 crore in Q2FY27, registering 28 per cent growth from a year earlier. Its retail book expanded 29 per cent to Rs 1,34,600 crore from Rs 1,04,607 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

Retail disbursements rose 27 per cent year-on-year to Rs 24,027 crore from Rs 18,883 crore. Growth was spread across rural and urban markets, with the lender continuing to expand its higher-yielding loan segments.
Personal Loans, Gold Finance Drive Growth

Personal loans recorded one of the strongest increases, with the book expanding 72 per cent year-on-year to Rs 18,664 crore from Rs 10,878 crore. Two-wheeler finance grew 24 per cent to Rs 16,158 crore, while quarterly disbursements in the segment increased 26 per cent to Rs 3,170 crore.

Gold finance recorded the sharpest expansion, with its loan book surging 242 per cent to Rs 5,043 crore from Rs 1,475 crore a year earlier. Gold loan disbursements jumped 229 per cent to Rs 3,237 crore from Rs 983 crore.

Housing loans and loans against property grew 20 per cent to Rs 32,846 crore, with quarterly disbursements rising 8 per cent to Rs 2,926 crore. The SME finance book increased 27 per cent to Rs 9,495 crore.

Rural business finance expanded 22 per cent year-on-year to Rs 33,465 crore. Farmer finance grew at a slower pace, with the book increasing 9 per cent to Rs 17,397 crore, while quarterly disbursements declined 1 per cent to Rs 1,643 crore.

L&T Finance is also increasing its focus on technology under its Lakshya 2031 strategy. Its PLANET app has crossed 2.7 crore downloads and now handles 94 per cent of customer service requests. The platform facilitated collections of Rs 2,168 crore and generated business worth Rs 5,934 crore during the quarter.

The company has introduced a dedicated rural interface for the app with multilingual capabilities, including Hindi, and has partnered with Pine Labs to introduce agentic commerce and payments on the PLANET platform.

L&T Finance said it continues to invest in artificial intelligence-led credit administration and portfolio management while expanding its distribution network across gold finance, micro loan against property, personal loans and two-wheeler finance.
